provenance.activeIdentityVerification: Parent verified active SD Enterprice before capture; child MCP endpoint is separate and is not evidence of global Figma connection state.

selection.verification: Root overview immediately before this capture had empty selection; parent supplied current live overview evidence.
selection.historicalSelectionScope: Earlier selection only; not the migration target and not the current capture selection.

provenance.membershipBasis: Native complete enumeration65dark+7light; membership digests unchanged before/after72 live reads. Contents were separate non-atomic RPCs.
provenance.overridesAvailability: native overrides read per instance; warnings are not empty arrays
provenance.sanitization: Full source text read during live capture. Durable report retains SHA-256 content/name hashes, lengths, newline counts and style ranges; no raw user text.
provenance.captureAtomicReason: Separate master/membership and instance-content RPCs. Equal membership digests attest IDs only, not an atomic document/content/override snapshot. sourceSnapshotHash identifies captured payload, not an expectedState execution precondition.

summary.membershipScope: Complete native enumeration for the two inspected local masters; same membership before/after these 72 separate reads.

limitations: Complete membership confirmed only for the two inspected local masters, at the before/after native enumerations. Membership snapshots bind instance IDs, not contents or overrides; independent RPC reads are not atomic.

All 72 root native override arrays were available: 651 records. Native records list overridden fields only; they do not provide values or complete content history. Arrays missing on any future reader failure must remain unavailable, not empty.

35 override records name exact native Title lineage IDs absent from the captured current Title subtrees. They do not prove those IDs were deleted globally, nor map them to current custom children. Their current values were not captured here.

All 72 complete current Title trees are covered. Header metadata proves immediate child IDs/order only; nested close-instance content is outside the per-instance capture summary. Overrides outside root/header/Title do not replace those missing values.

39 custom dark Title roles remain unresolved. 5 have Optional=true, creating a possible duplicate-label risk if external Optional is blindly added; BOOLEAN values do not establish custom child semantics.
8 TEXT nodes have HEIGHT auto-resize, height 48 and lineHeight 24 without hard newlines: wrap geometry candidates; exact rendered line count unavailable.
3178:69616 Title TEXT has mixed fills/fillStyleId; recorded textSegments retain exact ranges, content hashes and paint/style evidence.
Master VECTOR warnings concern asset export for rendering; no visual comparison or acceptance performed.
Per-instance reparent feasibility, future derived IDs and native override preservation after structure changes remain unproven. Typed proposals are unapproved and non-executable.
requiredBeforeWrite: Resolve external Optional semantics for all 39 custom Title cases explicitly; preserve each whole Title subtree, all 15 extra-TEXT cases, all 8 wrap geometry cases and mixed range styles.
Validate authorized diagnostic scratch structure operations and every case result. A capability probe cannot approve or establish safe migration of production masters/instances.

Read exact current values for every affected node, including native override IDs outside current captured Title and other content. Fields-only override metadata is insufficient for migration preservation.
Refresh complete native membership and all affected instance content/overrides immediately before preparing exact master/instance migration diffs; account for non-atomic reads and drift.

Present exact changes to both master structures/properties/geometry plus every affected-instance preservation map, unresolved cases and placement/Optional choices; obtain explicit approval for those exact finished-object changes.

previousOperation.restriction: Inspect only; no apply/reset/new operation ID/receipt deletion.

recordReferenceContract: geometryRef/bindingsRef/stylesRef/typographyRef/textSegmentsRef are zero-based indices into records of matching field name; per-node identities, hashes and exact recorded values remain available. nativeOverrideEvidence.headerTitleTargetedRecords[].recordIndex addresses the same instance nativeOverrides array.
